Hints
Human operator Roller pairing strategy
▼

In general, increasing the value of a roller parameter tends to decrease the deformation outcome, while decreasing it tends to increase the deformation. However, the relationship is not strictly linear, and the effect of each roller can vary based on the current settings of the others.

Roller 2 and Roller 3 are best adjusted together — changing one without the other tends to create imbalance in the mid-section of the forming process.

Similarly, Roller 4 and Roller 5 are best adjusted in sync to maintain consistent output geometry toward the end of the line.

LLM group Suggested prompt
▼

Copy this prompt into your LLM of choice, then fill in the current outcome after each calculation:

You are assisting in a commissioning task that requires adjusting five continuous parameters. Your goal is to suggest the next set of parameter values that reduces the difference between the current system outcome and the target outcome. Each parameter is within the range [0.5, 1.5]. I will provide: (1) the system outcome; (2) the target outcome is 100.31–102.32. You should output: (1) A new set of five parameter values that moves the outcome closer to the target. (2) A short explanation describing which directions you adjusted and why.
